content.text:
`task lint` now passes. It was reporting 16 `ICN001` errors, each a file using `import datetime` where the project wants `import datetime as dt`.

I fixed them with `ruff --select ICN001 --fix --unsafe-fixes`. That touched 16 files across alloq-commons, alloq-dashboard and alloq-project. Ruff marks the fix unsafe because it renames every use in each file. After the fix, 5 files needed reformatting because the shorter name changed line wrapping, so I ran `ruff format` too.

The tests for alloq-commons, alloq-project and alloq-dashboard pass (642). I didn't run the rest of the suite, `task typecheck` or the app tests.
